items.title: How do you handle AI security for automated vulnerability management?
items.raw_excerpt: Hello World! So I am new to the world of cybersecurity, and after some back and forth with AI, I chose to use a specific tool that was recommended for automated vulnerability detection & patching, but I think the issue I encountered is something common to all similar platforms that provide AI security fixes in 2026. It proposed a fix to an issue labeled 'critical'. I gave the specific file and the fix to Gemini, and, it disagreed strongly. My trust in the platform immediately degraded. It shows in my thinking that AI security platforms for repositories are unreliable, unless you cross check every critical/high vulnerability as a human with another AI tool as well. items.title: Omnara – Open-Source Alternative to Claude Managed Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Hey y'all, Kartik from Omnara ( https://omnara.com ) here. We're building an open-source API for running durable agents. You create an agent with an API call, and Omnara runs the agent loop, gives the agent sandboxes to run commands in, and handles secrets, permissions, and RBAC. Each agent's state is stored in Postgres, so agents survive restarts and cost nothing while idle. You can message them and stream their events over the API. You may remember us from our early days, when we made a remote-control phone app for Claude Code and Codex.
